# Film signature: a real diagonal drag scrolls the matrix to its canvas columns

## Context

The operator, 2026-10-11 00:0xZ, on the take at a852b8ca6e: the Workstation's 100k-row grid has columns at its right edge that hold offscreen canvases, never visible in the video, and the grid never gets scrolled — not vertically, not horizontally, and not diagonally by drag, which is the grid's own feature. The film's signature today is a `scroll` cue that sets the view's `scrollTop` in one step: a jump, not a motion, and the sparkline column (`type: 'sparkline'`, the framework-owned OffscreenCanvas path) stays out of frame because the matrix pane is ≈ 300 px wide against ≈ 1080 px of columns.

Design authority: the operator's note (a peer design input, derived here: the close's claim is "a hundred thousand rows cross their midpoint… the content never stopped living" — a visible diagonal drag through the rows into the canvas columns is that claim as motion); the 2026-09-23 pacing rule (a real gesture at hand tempo, never a held frame).

## The Problem

The grid's `Neo.grid.ScrollManager` has `dragScroll: true` by default: the main-thread addon `GridDragScroll` scrolls the body in both axes while the pointer drags it (`neo-mouse-drag-scroll`). Nothing in the tour exercises it: the dense tour and the film only scroll by `scrollTop`. The film's close therefore shows a static grid (after the sibling reveal leaf) with a jump, and the offscreen-canvas column — one of the grid's strongest demonstrations — never appears.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/workstation/tour/GestureDriver.mjs` `executeResizeStep` drives a real pointer drag through `run.service.driveDrag({source, destination: {deltaX, deltaY}, durationMs, steps})` with the film cursor riding the drive's clock — the pattern a grid drag can reuse on the grid body (`pane.view` / the body element of `Workspace.paneCache.scale`).
- `apps/workstation/view/TourController.mjs` `executeCue` + `cueVocabulary.mjs` `WORKSTATION_CUE_TYPES` + `fiveBeatFilm.mjs` `filmCueTypes` (the unit spec asserts the lists agree).
- `apps/workstation/view/ScalePane.mjs`: columns #, Work item, State, Throughput, Pulse (animatedChange), progress, sparkline (160 px, OffscreenCanvas), a component column; `rowHeight: 50`; `body.bufferColumnRange: 2`.
- The film witness (`WorkstationFilmTourNL.spec.mjs`) asserts one settled receipt per cue in screenplay order; the receipt of a new cue must carry its proof (scroll deltas in both axes).

## The Fix

A `grid-drag-scroll` cue: `{type: 'grid-drag-scroll', paneId: 'scale', deltaX, deltaY, strokes, options: {moveDelay: 33, moveSteps, showCursor: true}}` — the executor measures the grid view's rect, presses inside it and drives diagonal strokes at hand tempo as raw mouse-event brackets (`driveDrag` arms Neo drag sensors only and refuses the grid, whose drag-scroll is a plain DOM listener), three strokes because the pane is narrower than the matrix, the hand pausing and pressing again at the anchor between them; it returns the receipt of the Contract Ledger below, `applied` only when the scroll settled and both dragged axes reached their expected travel. In `film-signature`, after the reveal and the jump to the middle (M08 keeps its cue): the diagonal drag carries the view down and to the right until the sparkline column is on screen, then the readout and the living close. Unit spec: the cue in both lists, the screenplay validates; the film witness: the receipt's deltas (vertical and horizontal both non-zero).

## Contract Ledger

**Cue** `{type: 'grid-drag-scroll', paneId, deltaX, deltaY, anchor?, strokes?, options?}` — consumed by `TourController#executeCue` → `GestureDriver#executeGridDragScrollStep(step, options)`; listed in `WORKSTATION_CUE_TYPES` and `filmCueTypes`.
- `paneId` (String, required): a rendered grid pane in the workspace's pane cache (`'scale'`).
- `deltaX`, `deltaY` (Number, CSS px, at least one non-zero): pointer travel per stroke; negative drags the content left / up, so `scrollLeft` / `scrollTop` grow.
- `anchor` (`{x, y}` fractions of the view rect, default `0.5 / 0.5`): where each stroke presses.
- `strokes` (positive integer, default 1): strokes from the anchor; the hand lifts between them.
- `options.moveDelay` (ms between samples, default 16), `options.moveSteps` (samples per stroke, default 12), `options.showCursor` (the film cursor, default false), `options.attempts` (16 ms settle polls after the last release, default 180).

**Input** per stroke: `mousedown` on the grid body, `moveSteps` × `mousemove` on `document.body`, `mouseup` — raw events through `InteractionService#simulateEvent`, each sample dispatched after the previous one's acknowledgement plus `moveDelay`; the film cursor moves to a sample as that sample is dispatched, never ahead of an unacknowledged one.

**Receipt** `{applied, errors, proof}` with `proof = {before, after: {scrollLeft, scrollTop, settled}, dispatched (samples per stroke), strokes, travel}` and `travel = {deltaX, deltaY, requested, room, expected, observed, slack, met}`, the last six as `{x, y}`:
- `requested` = `|delta| × strokes`; `room` = the scroll room left from `before` (the last column position against the body's container width; row count × row height against the available height), `null` when the grid has not measured that side; `expected` = `min(requested, room)`, or `requested` when the room is unmeasured; `observed` = the scroll change projected on the dragged direction (the inertia tail may add, a bound clips); `slack` = one sample per stroke.
- `applied: true` only when the pane is rendered, every sample was dispatched, the scroll settled (two reads agreeing over six polls within `attempts`), and every dragged axis moved the dragged way with `observed ≥ expected − slack`.
- Failures by name (`applied: false`, `errors`, the `proof` retained once sampling began): no rendered pane or geometry; a refused sample; a tail unsettled within `attempts × 16` ms; travel short of the expected.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `grid-drag-scroll` is handled by `TourController#executeCue`, listed in both cue vocabularies, and the screenplay validates (`fiveBeatFilm.spec`).
- [ ] The headless film witness's receipt for the cue shows the tail settled and, per dragged axis, `observed ≥ expected − slack` with `expected = min(requested, room)` — three strokes of (−260, −120) at ≈ 33 ms samples (≈ 1.2 s per stroke): `scrollTop` grows by at least 360 less the slack, `scrollLeft` by at least `min(780, room)` less the slack, each axis with at least a row / a column of room; a direction-only or pixel-sized travel fails the witness. (Reconciled with the shipped shape: three raw-event strokes, not one `driveDrag` motion — see the Contract Ledger.)
- [x] Post-merge, deferred to #15252 (not demanded before this merge): the take's frames during the close show the matrix rows moving and the sparkline (canvas) column entering the frame. — Observed: the re-take `2026-10-11T00-55-16-516Z` at dev `00b6f2aa6a` (the #15252 re-take comment of 2026-10-11 01:01Z): three strokes 90.00–95.06 s pan the matrix through State → Throughput → Pulse → Load → Living signal (the canvas sparklines, in frame by ≈ 93 s) → Action; the rows cross throughout.

## Out of Scope

- Bringing the matrix and the feed in front before the close (the sibling leaf, filed first).
- Any engine change to the grid or its drag-scroll addon.
